camera.shot_scale_bias: whatever the operator could grab; framing found late
camera.height: wherever the camera was held, dropped or mounted

lighting.practicals: auto white balance hunting between sources

palette.grade: clipped highlights, lifted blacks, compression artifacts implied

rules: subjects half out of frame until the camera finds them
composition.movement_of_subject: people react to the camera, block it, wave it away

sound.ambience_bias: wind on the mic, handling thumps, breath of the person filming

must_include: the camera exists inside the scene and is handled by someone in it

notes: The camera is a witness, not a narrator.
